_readme: Latest LIVE store version per app, read by each app's Update available prompt. Bump android/ios only after that release is live in the store; set min to force an update below that version. lastline_ads = Last Line ad frequency (2.2.4+, see Assets/_Game/Scripts/Meta/AdTuning.cs). lastline_events = Last Line limited events (2.3.3+): halloween on/off inside its date window (Oct 30 15:55 - Nov 3 15:55 UTC); halloweenEnd (ISO UTC) extends the end.
